# Canonical Roles

<!-- Generated by `python -m forge.docsgen`. Do not edit directly. -->

Generated directly from `forge/topgen/ip/canonical_roles.yaml`
(loaded via
`forge.contracts.contract_verifier.load_canonical_role_vocab()`) —
the canonical *role* vocabulary specifically, distinct from the
[Protocols](protocols.md) and [Interface Members](interface-members.md)
vocabularies, which are separate, independently-validated sources.
See [Contracts and Protocols](../concepts/contracts-and-protocols.md)
for what these roles mean conceptually.

| Role | Description | Direction | Width | Required | Generation-authoritative | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `bx_sync_in` | BX0 synchronisation pulse input (marks start-of-BX0 from LHC clock) | input | 1 | no | no | active |
| `cfg_source_reg` | 64-bit framework register driving the config distribution block | input | 64 | no | no | active |
| `cfg_valid` | Configuration-word valid strobe (1-bit, same cycle as cfg_word) | input | 1 | no | yes | active |
| `cfg_valid_out` | Forwarded configuration-valid output | output | 1 | no | no | active |
| `cfg_word` | 64-bit packed configuration word (CSP-format cfg64 input) | input | 64 | no | yes | active |
| `cfg_word_out` | 64-bit packed configuration word output forwarded downstream | output | 64 | no | no | active |
| `clock_primary` | Primary clock input | input | 1 | yes | yes | active |
| `clock_secondary` | Secondary clock (cross-clock-domain modules only). RESERVED: declared for a future multi-clock-domain / CDC release. The framework accepts this role in a contract but currently has no clock-domain model, no CDC validation, and performs no special wiring or checking for it — declaring it has no functional effect today. See docs/IP_INTERFACE_POLICY.md "Reserved roles". | input | 1 | no | no | reserved |
| `ctrl_new_event` | New-event strobe input consumed by a downstream processing module | input | 1 | no | no | active |
| `input_ref_ptr` | Scalar reference-hit pointer / selector word entering a processing module (e.g., layermem ref_ptr input from the priority arbiter). | input |  | no | no | active |
| `input_stream_0` | Primary scalar data input stream. Width is determined by the IP; 67 bits is the standard CSP packed-stub format. | input |  | no | no | active |
| `input_stream_1` | Second scalar data input stream (if IP has two independent inputs) | input |  | no | no | active |
| `input_stream_array` | Array of homogeneous input streams sharing the same width. Use raw_port_prefix + count in the mapping spec entry. | input |  | no | no | active |
| `output_ref_hit` | Scalar reference-hit data output | output |  | no | no | active |
| `output_ref_ptr` | Scalar reference-hit pointer / selector word output | output |  | no | no | active |
| `output_stream_0` | Primary scalar data output stream | output |  | no | no | active |
| `output_stream_1` | Second scalar data output stream | output |  | no | no | active |
| `output_stream_array` | Array of homogeneous output streams | output |  | no | no | active |
| `reset_primary` | Primary synchronous reset. Active high unless the mapping spec sets active_level: low. | input | 1 | yes | yes | active |
| `reset_secondary` | Secondary reset (optional complement to reset_primary). RESERVED: see clock_secondary above — no clock-domain model exists yet, so this role currently has no functional effect. | input | 1 | no | no | reserved |
| `timing_bx_counter` | Running BX counter output used for latency tracing | output | 12 | no | no | active |
| `timing_cycle_in_bx` | Cycle-within-BX counter output (0–8, resets each BX) | output | 4 | no | no | active |
| `timing_new_event` | New-event strobe broadcast output. Asserted at the start of each BX when new detector data is expected. | output | 1 | no | no | active |
